title: Minimax bounds for watermarked and masked recursive discrete distribution estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.31091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Watermarking has been proposed as a way to identify synthetic samples in estimation settings where no metadata is available to distinguish them from real samples, but its precise effects remain unexplored. In the absence of a distinguishing mechanism, it has been shown that adding synthetic samples significantly reduces the marginal efficacy of new real samples. In this work, we study the minimax loss of such recursive discrete distribution estimation in the presence of watermarks in contrast to the unassisted and oracle-assisted losses. When the fraction of real samples vanishes asymptotically, we provide a lower bound that shows that it is impossible to improve performance by adding watermarks unless the false negative rate of detection also vanishes. translated_title: 带水印与掩蔽的递归离散分布估计的极小极大界
translated_abstract: 水印技术被提出用于在缺乏元数据以区分合成样本与真实样本的估计场景中识别合成样本，但其确切影响尚未被探索。已有研究表明，在缺乏区分机制的情况下，添加合成样本会显著降低新真实样本的边际效能。在这项工作中，我们研究了在存在水印的情况下这种递归离散分布估计的极小极大损失，并与无辅助损失和预言机辅助损失进行对比。当真实样本的比例渐近趋于零时，我们给出了一个下界，表明除非水印检测的假阴性率也趋于零，否则无法通过添加水印来提升性能。此外，我们证明在大多数情形下，一系列简单确定性估计器的最坏情况损失在常数因子内与相应的下界相匹配。最后，我们提出……
tldr: 本文为带水印的递归离散分布估计建立了极小极大损失下界，证明除非水印检测的假阴性率趋于零，否则添加水印无法提升估计性能，且简单确定性估计器在常数因子内即可达到该下界。
en_tdlr: This work establishes minimax lower bounds for recursive discrete distribution estimation with watermarks, proving that adding watermarks cannot improve performance unless the detection false negative rate vanishes, while simple deterministic estimators match these bounds up to constant factors.
